solutionSql:
SELECT id, status
FROM shipment_scans_large
WHERE id < 5000
  AND status = 'delivered'
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 1;
ambiguities: The instructions do not mention the order or plan requirement. 'An order the index can supply' appears only in the summary, and the plan check forbids a Sort node. A learner reading only the instructions would not know that a Sort fails.
notes: Result is id 4999 (delivered), the largest delivered id below 5000. Plan is Limit over Index Scan (Backward) with no Sort on all three datasets.
